# Metal Roof Central

> Metal Roof Central installs modular and stone-coated metal roofing for homeowners and contractors, and trains a new workforce of metal roofing technicians — including youth aging out of foster care and high school students.

Metal Roof Central, LLC is a metal roofing company and workforce-training program. It installs stone-coated metal roofing, modular metal roof systems, metal shingles and tiles, and hurricane-zone/energy-efficient roofing. It partners with foster care group homes and high schools to train young people as metal roof technicians and connects trained technicians with contractor employers.
